name: San Ysidro Ranch
positioning: Historic cottage retreat in the foothills of Santa Barbara, with dining included in every stay
best_for: Couples who want a private cottage with its own enclosed garden

facts.text: San Ysidro Ranch is set in the leafy foothills of Santa Barbara.
Ty Warner purchased San Ysidro Ranch in 2000.
John Huston finished writing the screenplay for The African Queen while staying at the Ranch.
Past guests include Groucho Marx and Winston Churchill.
Individually decorated cottages have a gated entry with an enclosed garden and adjacent private parking.
Each cottage is named after a variety of flora, such as Lotus, Fig and Honeysuckle.
The Stonehouse restaurant is set inside a 19th-century citrus packing house.
Afternoon Tea is served in the Veranda with house-made pastries, seasonal scones and tea sandwiches.
The Ranch has a 14,000-bottle wine cellar with a 70-vintage vertical collection of Chateau Petrus dating back to 1945.
The property has a pool and its own golf-putting course.
Spa therapies use oils made from the property's own lavender, rosemary and lemons.

highlights.text: Dining at the Ranch is included complimentary with each stay.
John and Jackie Kennedy honeymooned at the Ranch in the cottage that now bears their name.
Cottage furnishings include Persian rugs, stone fireplaces, king-sized four-poster beds, oversized sunken spas and outdoor rainfall showers.
Laurence Olivier and Vivien Leigh exchanged midnight wedding vows on the grounds.
The Speakeasy, inspired by Prohibition-era bars, offers handcrafted cocktails, rare spirits and live music nightly.

considerations.text: The hillside property is sloped, but there are not many stairs and access ramps exist where needed.
WhataHotel notes the location requires transportation to reach downtown Santa Barbara.
